title: Glen Arbour
specs: The Pitch: space for up to 50 people, with chairs, tables, bar, and 6 TVs including an 82" Smart TV
The Snug: seating for up to 20 people, cozy setting for private functions or meetings
Arbour View Room: 1400 sq ft, main floor, high ceilings, deck and gazebo with golf course views, suitable for private parties and small weddings
includes: Access to golf simulators with multiple course options and graphics
Food and beverage service from the Deerfield Pub
blurb: Guests can play golf on simulators featuring courses worldwide, with food and drink from the Deerfield Pub nearby. The venue offers event spaces for private functions such as meetings, parties, and small weddings. Spaces include The Pitch, The Snug, and the Arbour View Room with views of the golf course.
